topics: calm scientific observation with a gentle clear pulse
prompt: Create a complete original 60-second instrumental cue in ambient style. Use soft analog pads, felt piano, sparse bell, light pulse. Tempo 80 BPM. Immediate short melodic hook and steady rhythm from the first beat. Keep this groove present until the final bar. In the final second, all instruments play one resolved tonic chord and stop together, allowing a short clean natural tail. This must end musically, with no fade and no abrupt unfinished phrase. No slow intro, silent gap, long outro or atmospheric wash. Pure instrumental performance: instruments exclusively. No human voice, speech, singing, humming, choir, vocal samples or crowd sounds anywhere.

description.en: A smooth, atmospheric, and slightly melancholic electronic track featuring a prominent synth melody, pads, and a subtle beat. It has a reflective and calm feel.
description.zh: 这是一个流畅、大气且略带忧郁的电子音乐片段，以突出的合成器旋律、衬底音和微妙的节拍为特色。它给人一种沉思和平静的感觉。
